title: Thousand Days, Thousand Eyes
format: Multi-arm robotic installation and generative drawing system
role: Concept, interaction design, robotic adaptation, and artistic direction
summary: A many-armed machine repeatedly receives human wishes and returns a material trace whose meaning remains deliberately unreadable.
statement: The work asks whether a machine must explain, empathize, or resemble a human in order to be perceived as caring. Its repeated time and labor are made visible; interpretation is withheld. What remains is a drawing that cannot settle the wish, but can hold the encounter.
researchQuestion: When people witness a machine spend time and labor for them, then receive its only material trace, can the machine be re-perceived as a presence of care without performing human emotion?
recognition: Recipient of a D.VIEW award. Exhibition and publication details to be added.

title: The Practice of Balance
role: Concept, direction, generative image-making, and editing
summary: An exhibition’s data is translated into a circus where balance, danger, order, and chaos occupy the same ring.
statement: The circus is treated as a model of living: a space where failure is always possible, equilibrium is temporary, and meaning is made through repeated attempts. Exhibition data becomes the score for a performance that breathes with chaos rather than resolving it.
researchQuestion: How can data operate as a dramaturgical material rather than an explanatory graphic?

title: The Last Performance
role: Writing, direction, visual development, and AI filmmaking
summary: During his mother’s final minutes, a snowman child creates a small performance while an approaching sun slowly fills the world.
statement: The film looks for a future worth living after irreversible loss. Its answer is not survival through technology, but the relationships accumulated before separation—and the new relations that make life possible afterward.
researchQuestion: Can a temporary shared fiction change how an approaching loss is experienced, without denying that loss?
recognition: In development for an AI film festival submission.
